name: YGSOFT Inc.
summary: YGSOFT Inc. operates in IT industry in China. The company offers financial and management information solutions and other services. It also provides various services comprising strategic performance, shared services, grid digitalization, dual control of carbon emissions, resource management, production and operation, energy and electricity marketization, intelligent fuel transmission, storage and inspection, data operations, and industrial internet. YGSOFT Inc. was founded in 2001 and is based in Zhuhai, China.
